versions.name: Preservation
versions.text: You can't draw cards while your hand is full.

versions.name: Preservation
versions.text: You won't draw at the start of the turn if your hand is full.

versions.name: Preservation
versions.text: You always overdraw the card with the lowest cost in your deck instead of the card at the top of your deck.

versions.name: Preservation
versions.text: Whenever you would overdraw a card, take fatigue DMG instead.
